value: GHGT-17 conference paper, preprint posted on SSRN (abstract 5012849); copyright the authors; numbers extracted as facts

Burns, A. and Davila Gomez, Y. (2024). Lessons learned in the design and construction of the Brevik CCS facility. Proceedings of the 17th International Conference on Greenhouse Gas Control Technologies (GHGT-17), Calgary, Canada, 20-24 October 2024. SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5012849

Locators are printed GHGT-17 pages (1-8 = PDF pages). Qualitative lessons-learned paper (project management, piping, liquid CO2 design, construction, commissioning, operator training). The only technology-level numbers: capture capacity 400 kt/y liquefied CO2 and that this is half of the plant CO2 (share-to-capture 50%); regeneration heat from cement waste heat plus capture-plant excess heat; status under construction (operational 2025). No energy, capture rate or cost figures printed. Minor context numbers in other-values.
